title: The Missing Key
scene: At 9:45 PM, the hotel master key vanished. A fire alarm held the corridor locked from 9:30 to 10:00.

suspects.name: Vera Ash
suspects.testimony: I was at the front desk at 9:45, calming guests.
suspects.alibiProof: The desk camera shows Vera at 9:43 and 9:48.

suspects.name: Walter Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the lobby at 9:45 with everyone else.
suspects.alibiProof: The lobby camera shows Walter at 9:41 and 9:52.

suspects.name: Xiomara Vale
suspects.testimony: I was on floor four at 9:45, restocking towels.
suspects.contradiction: The floor four linen closet was sealed by the alarm, and the key ring was in Xiomara's cart.

suspects.name: Yosef Lund
suspects.testimony: I was by the elevator at 9:45, directing guests.
suspects.alibiProof: The elevator camera shows Yosef at 9:44 and 9:50.
